what: a knight's longsword: a long straight double-edged blade with a central groove, a plain straight crossguard, a two-hand grip and a wheel pommel.
colours: The blade, crossguard and pommel are plain neutral grey steel with bright highlights and no tint of colour in them. The grip is wrapped in dark brown leather.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, pommel at the bottom left corner and point at the top right corner, the whole sword inside the picture.

what: a dagger: a short straight double-edged blade no longer than a hand and a half, a small crossguard and a short grip with a round pommel.
colours: The blade, guard and pommel are plain neutral grey steel with bright highlights and no tint of colour in them. The grip is wrapped in dark brown leather.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, pommel at the bottom left corner and point at the top right corner.
must_show: blade no longer than twice the grip

what: a glaive: a very long straight wooden pole with one broad single-edged curved blade, like a big knife, fixed to its top end.
colours: The blade is plain neutral grey steel with bright highlights and no tint of colour in it. The pole is dark brown wood with two iron-grey bands.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the blade at the top right corner. The pole is four times as long as the blade.
must_show: one single-edged blade at the top end only

what: a flanged mace: a short thick metal handle with a heavy head made of six flat steel flanges set round the top like the fins of a dart.
colours: The head and handle are plain neutral grey steel with bright highlights and no tint of colour in them. The lower grip is wrapped in dark brown leather.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, grip at the bottom left and head at the top right.

what: a longbow: one tall, gently curved stave of wood, thick at the middle grip and tapering to both tips, strung with a single taut bowstring from tip to tip, and no arrow.
colours: The whole stave is plain neutral pale grey wood with no tint of colour in it. The grip in the middle is wrapped in dark brown leather; the string is off-white.
pose: It stands upright but leaning: lower tip at the bottom left, upper tip at the top right, the curve bulging to the upper left.

what: a knight's plate helmet with nobody inside it: a rounded steel skull, a pointed visor with a narrow eye slit and breathing holes, and a short neck guard.
colours: The whole helmet is plain neutral grey steel with bright highlights and dark seams and no tint of colour in it.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, sitting level, the eye slit black and empty.

what: the body of a suit of full plate armour with nobody inside it: a steel breastplate with a central ridge, layered shoulder plates, and a skirt of overlapping steel bands at the waist. It has no helmet, no arms and no legs: only the torso piece, hollow, with dark empty openings at the neck and arms.
colours: Every plate is plain neutral grey steel with bright highlights and dark seams and no tint of colour in it. The few straps are dark brown leather.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, as if hung in the air.

what: a pair of tall leather boots with nobody in them, standing side by side: soft turned-down tops, a seam down the front and thick soles.
colours: Both boots are plain neutral mid-grey leather with soft highlights and no tint of colour in them. The soles are a darker grey.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, the two boots upright and touching.

what: a kite shield: a tall shield, rounded at the top and tapering to a point at the bottom, with a raised rim, a central boss and a row of rivets round the edge.
colours: The whole face of the shield is plain neutral grey steel with bright highlights and no tint of colour in it, and no painted emblem.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, its face towards the viewer.

what: a long hooded cloak with nobody inside it, hanging open as if from a peg: a deep empty hood at the top and heavy folds of cloth falling to a ragged hem, fastened at the throat by a small round clasp.
colours: The whole cloak is plain neutral mid-grey cloth with soft highlights and deep grey folds and no tint of colour in it. The clasp is dull brass.
pose: Seen from the front, the hood dark and empty.

what: a finger ring: a thick round hoop of gold with a clear round hole through the middle, and one oval red ruby in a claw mount on top of the hoop.
colours: Warm yellow gold, a deep red ruby with one white highlight.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, the hoop standing upright like the letter O with the hole plainly showing and the stone at the top.
must_show: a round hoop with a visible hole

what: a potion: a small round-bellied glass vial with a short neck and a cork stopper tied down with a thread, three-quarters full of smoky black liquid with grey swirls in it.
colours: Clear greenish glass, smoky black liquid, a brown cork.
pose: Seen from the front, standing upright.
